integrity: The universal claim is proved combinatorially. Exhaustive finite checks are supplementary stress tests and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes finite, connected, simple, nonbipartite, square-free graphs.
The root-selected spine need not be canonical up to graph isomorphism.

A residual originality risk remains from older box-complex/simple-homotopy literature under alternate formulations; checked sources did not state the direct collapse onto the root-selected graph on the original vertex set.
title: Direct graph spines for nonbipartite square-free neighborhood complexes
